claim_boundary: This protocol defines a no-training auxiliary quantum--liquid difference route. It preserves the gas MACE branch exactly but does not assert that an auxiliary QM density is a MACE density. It does not change a public Route-2 profile, supply a physical liquid asset, authorize a total-solvation, force, PES, optimization, scan, MD, NVE, or accuracy claim.

construction.name: route2-v0-auxiliary-qm-liquid-difference-v1
construction.gas_mace_term: E_MACE,gas(R) is evaluated by the unmodified official MACE-POLAR checkpoint at zero reaction field.
construction.auxiliary_gas_state: A_aux^gas(R)=min_n A_aux^gas[n;R] with a declared auxiliary QM functional, basis, charge, spin, geometry, and numerical settings.
construction.auxiliary_liquid_state: A_aux^sol(R;s)=stat_{n,N,lambda}[A_aux^gas[n;R]+Phi_s[N]+U_s[n,N;R]+lambda C[n,N]], where all auxiliary electronic and liquid degrees of freedom are stationary in one declared scalar.
construction.required_energy_ledger: G_V0-AQ(R;s)=E_MACE,gas(R)+[A_aux^sol(R;s)-A_aux^gas(R)]+DeltaG_s^circ. The auxiliary gas subtraction is mandatory; DeltaG_s^circ is present only in a declared physical liquid standard-state convention.
construction.auxiliary_state_boundary: The auxiliary electronic density is neither MACE density coefficients nor a projected/relabelled MACE density. It must not be injected into MACE field features or used to update MACE-POLAR.
construction.v0_aq_e_control: A source-bound self-consistent auxiliary QM--PCM gas-to-PCM-SCF total-energy difference is permitted only as a fixed-geometry electronic-continuum stationarity control. It contains no SMD CDS, target-solvation label, standard-state term, total-solvation claim, or solvent ranking.
construction.v0_aq_l_completion: A physical total free-energy calculation requires one molecular liquid functional with frozen solvent assets for Phi_s, U_s, pressure/cavity/dispersion physics, and the standard-state convention before target-solvation records are inspected.

stationarity_and_force_contract.pcm_control_lagrangian: L_aux,PCM[n,sigma]=A_aux^gas[n;R]+0.5 sigma^T A_R sigma+sigma^T B_R n.
stationarity_and_force_contract.pcm_control_stationarity: delta A_aux^gas/delta n+B_R^T sigma=0 and A_R sigma+B_R n=0.
stationarity_and_force_contract.pcm_control_energy: DeltaA_aux^PCM=A_aux^(PCM-SCF)-A_aux^(gas-SCF), using fully converged stationary total energies rather than an implementation-specific isolated PCM component.
stationarity_and_force_contract.derivative_rule: dG_V0-AQ/dR=dE_MACE,gas/dR+partial_R L_aux^sol|_* - partial_R A_aux^gas|_*. No legacy MACE field-response derivative is permitted.
stationarity_and_force_contract.force_gate: An analytic auxiliary gradient at a fixed geometry is insufficient for a force/PES claim. Full same-scalar coordinate derivatives, smooth-cavity/operator, central-difference refinement, rigid-motion, and closed-loop-work gates are required first.

required_before_target_scoring: A versioned molecular solvent site model or classical liquid density functional.
Bulk temperature, pressure, number density, and an equation of state or equivalent thermodynamic-pressure definition.
Frozen bulk correlations/susceptibility or the complete declared classical excess functional.
A source-provenanced short-range and dispersion interaction in the same liquid free-energy convention.
A standard-state convention and a declaration that no target MNSol, FreeSolv, development, confirmation, or blind label selected any input.
liquid_asset_contract.dielectric_only_rule: A solvent name or scalar dielectric may support an explicitly labelled electrostatic diagnostic only. It rejects V0-AQ-L total-free-energy execution.

upstream_family_policy.joint_or_classical_dft: Admissible only with frozen independently sourced liquid assets. JDFTx ClassicalDFT/fluid-solvent is an upstream asset interface, not authority to tune property overrides from solvation errors.
upstream_family_policy.qm_3drism_scf_or_mdft: Admissible only with a jointly stationary auxiliary QM--liquid scalar, frozen bulk/site assets, a declared closure/free-energy convention, and no GAFF/AM1-BCC substitution for the claimed solute source.
upstream_family_policy.salsa: Electric-response reference only: published SaLSA retains a fitted dispersion contribution, so it is not a strictly no-fit total-free-energy endpoint in this protocol.

liquid_asset_contract.current_inventory: No physical 11-solvent V0-AQ-L asset is registered in this checkout. The V0-AQ-E PCM control may not bypass that blocker.

validation_sequence: Source-bind the same auxiliary QM gas and liquid electronic functional, basis, geometry, charge, spin, and numerical settings; require convergence of every stationary state.
Verify the auxiliary gas subtraction and reject a duplicate gas term, a standalone PCM component, an extra half-coupling, SMD CDS, a MACE-field update, or a fitted scale.
Treat V0-AQ-E only as a fixed-geometry electronic-continuum structural control and do not read target-solvation labels for it.
Register complete frozen physical liquid assets for at least eleven solvent strata before V0-AQ-L target scoring.
Before any force claim, prove the same-scalar gradient, smooth-cavity/operator, central-difference refinement, rigid-motion, and nuclear closed-loop-work gates.
Freeze development, disjoint confirmation, and external-blind record manifests only after structural validation; every record must satisfy the preregistered maximum-error gate without method changes.
decision_rule: Failure of a stationarity, source-boundary, liquid-asset, force, or per-record accuracy gate rejects the frozen candidate. It does not authorize post-training, fine-tuning, experimental fitting, MAP/UQ calibration, response repair, or error-driven parameter selection.
